contract.purpose: Make all MyGRACE skills easy to invoke from the MAGRA web chat composer and command palette.
contract.scope: Extend slash suggestions, `/api/slash`, command palette, and chat submission routing for `/mygrace:*` commands.

ux-rules.rule-1: Do not create a separate MyGRACE page before chat command invocation works.
ux-rules.rule-2: Commands must be discoverable by typing `/mygrace` in the composer.
ux-rules.rule-3: Long flows reuse existing plan, checkpoint, choice, and revision modals.
ux-rules.rule-4: Compatibility aliases such as `/mygrace_init` route to canonical `/mygrace:init` instead of becoming plain chat text.
